synthetic_long_horizon_tracking.description: Scaled 192-frame synthetic long-horizon tactile tracking benchmark. The scored targets below are the packaged reproduction reference values for this reduced benchmark; the original paper Table IV values remain in paper_context because they are not directly comparable to the synthetic substitute.

rotation_mae_deg.description: Mean rotational pose error over the evaluated slice; lower values indicate better tactile tracking.

translation_mae_mm.description: Mean translational pose error in millimeters over the evaluated slice; lower values indicate better tactile tracking.

loop_closure_quality.description: Loop-closure behavior for the scaled 192-frame synthetic benchmark. The scored targets below are the packaged reproduction reference values; the original paper Table II loop statistics remain in paper_context because the full real episodes are longer and denser than this substitute.

accepted_loops.description: Number of accepted loop closures in the evaluated slice; retained as a weak productivity signal.

valid_loops.description: Accepted loop closures whose measured relative pose agrees with the ground-truth revisit relation.

valid_loop_recall.description: Valid loop closures normalized by the loop-opportunity budget for the evaluated benchmark slice; this keeps the loop primary metric comparable across scaled sequence lengths.

valid_loop_rate.description: Fraction of accepted loop closures that are valid; methods that accept no loops receive zero so abstention does not satisfy the loop-closure constraint.

false_loop_rate.description: Fraction of accepted loop closures that violate the ground-truth revisit relation; this penalizes unsafe loop acceptance.

synthetic_reconstruction.description: Scaled tactile surface reconstruction benchmark for the packaged 192-frame synthetic sequence. The scored targets below are the packaged reproduction reference values; the original paper Table VI reconstruction metrics remain in paper_context because they use real object scans and physical GelSight contacts.

chamfer_distance_mm.description: Symmetric Chamfer distance between the reconstructed touched surface and the known target surface, reported in millimeters.

normal_cosine_distance.description: Average nearest-neighbor surface-normal cosine similarity between the reconstructed and target touched surfaces; a perfect match is 1.0.
